=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4980-4999 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: When `mktemp` falls back to `/dev/null`, the captured `gh_retry` stderr is discarded and the PR-metadata failure warning becomes empty.
  WHY: All five reviewers pointed to the same failure path where `/dev/null` causes the diagnostic text to vanish.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4980-4997 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The PR-metadata temp file is reported as not being removed on the `gh_retry` failure path.
  WHY: qwen identified a cleanup gap, but deepseek reviewed the same block and reported both success and failure branches remove the file, so this finding is disputed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2150-2168 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `integration_branch_exists` treats non-404 API errors as “branch exists,” so the helper fails open instead of surfacing uncertainty.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on impact, but they all described the same fail-open helper behavior and its reliance on the later compare call.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9385-9400 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The default-branch preflight uses `_safe_gh_jq` output without validating that it is a sane branch name.
  WHY: All three reviewers pointed at the same missing validation around `CWS_DEFAULT_BRANCH`; the code only checks for empty output, not malformed output.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2190-2191 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: An empty `integration_branch` or `default_branch` is collapsed to `ahead_by=0`, which can hide state corruption for direct callers.
  WHY: The current caller guards this case, but the helper itself cannot distinguish “no integration branch configured” from a lost state field.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3971-4067 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: On compare-API failures in the pinned-merged and recorded-PR re-checks, final-merge state is cleared without posting the tracking comment that explains why.
  WHY: Both reviewers identified the same observability gap on the finalize re-check failure paths.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2578-2598 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Adding `--integration-ahead-by` can break mixed-version shell/Python pairs when the wrapper passes the new flag to an older parser.
  WHY: The bootstrap usually keeps scripts in sync, but reviewers noted the same version-skew failure mode if wrapper and parser come from different revisions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4980-4996 | confidence=3

  WHY: The empty-string check catches one class of failure, but malformed output still flows into the compare path and produces confusing warnings.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2190-2191 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: An empty `integration_branch` or `default_branch` is treated the same as a deleted branch and returns `ahead_by=0`.
  WHY: The current caller guards this case, but direct callers of the helper would be unable to distinguish missing configuration from state corruption.

  PROBLEM: On compare-API failure in the recorded-PR re-discovery re-check, the code clears `final_pr` without posting a tracking comment.
  WHY: This is the same observability gap as the pinned-merged path, but on the recorded-PR branch.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2593-2598 | confidence=3
